{{# Wrapper element. Opts into the `checkboxRequiredGroup` Alpine component only when the field has the `required` rule, so Alpine manages the group's HTML5 `required` state in the browser (see comment block at the end of this file). #}}
{{# Hidden input. Guarantees the field's handle appears in submitted form data even when no boxes are checked, so the backend sees an empty array (and can run the `required` rule) rather than a missing key. #}} {{# Iterate the field's configured options. Each iteration exposes the option's submitted `value` as `option` and its display string as `label` (which may be null when the blueprint uses simple string options rather than `value: label` pairs). #}} {{ foreach:options as="option|label" }} {{# Per-option Bootstrap form-check wrapper. The `form-check-inline` modifier lays the options on a single line when the field's `inline` config is true; otherwise they stack vertically. #}}
{{# Checkbox input. `name="{{ handle }}[]"` makes the browser POST every checked value under the same array key. `is-invalid` mirrors Bootstrap validation styling when this field has a server-side error. `required` is emitted on every box and managed at runtime by Alpine (see wrapper above and the comment block at the end of this file). #}} {{# Option label. The matching `for` attribute ties the label to the input's `id`, so clicking the label toggles the checkbox and assistive tech announces the two as a pair. #}}
{{ /foreach:options }}
{{# ================================================================================ Group "required" handling ================================================================================ HTML5 `required` on demands that *that specific* box be checked, so emitting it on every option in a group would block submission until every box is ticked — not the "at least one must be selected" behavior we want for a required checkbox group. When this field has the `required` validation rule, the wrapper
opts into the `checkboxRequiredGroup` Alpine component (registered in resources/js/site.js, defined in resources/js/checkbox-required-group.js). On init and on any change inside the wrapper, the component clears `required` from every box in the group if any one is checked, and restores it when none are. Server-side validation in Statamic still catches empty submissions for users without JS. Radio buttons don't need this — the browser natively treats `required` on any radio in a named group as "one in the group must be selected" because radios are mutually exclusive. Checkboxes are not, so we manage it ourselves. ================================================================================ #}}
